lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Lu4Au4Br24 (reduced formula Cs2LuAuBr6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Au and Lu each in octahedral environments of six Br neighbors, while Cs adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor Br arrangement; the periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. The same analysis reports corner-sharing between Au- and Lu-centered octahedra, and face-sharing between Au octahedra and Cs 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as between Cs and Lu polyhedra.
